params.body:
## Summary

- The order row's action icons (`resources/views/offertes/indexOrders.blade.php`) render the transport truck lighter than its neighbours. The truck link always carries a `ui-action-button--solid-*` colour modifier, including `ui-action-button--solid-grey` for "no transport requested yet" — the most common state — which sets `--ui-action-ink: var(--brand-faint)` (`#98a2b3`). The shield, preview and edit icons use the plain `ui-action-button` (no modifier) for their own "nothing started yet" state, which resolves to `--brand-gray` (`#475467`), visibly darker.
- Dropped the `--solid-grey` fallback for "no transport yet" so the truck uses the same plain `ui-action-button` ink as the other three in that state. The truck is not disabled in this state (`ShowTransport` already gates whether it renders at all; when it renders it always opens the transport modal), so it should read the same as an available action, not a paler one. The colour-coded modifier is kept once a transport actually exists (warning/danger/success/grey by `Transport::StateColorClass`), which is meaningful status colour, not a contrast bug.
- Normalised all four icons to the `fas` Font Awesome style (`fa fa-truck` → `fas fa-truck`, `fa fa-eye` → `fas fa-eye`, `fa fa-edit` → `fas fa-edit`; the shield was already `fas`). The app ships a v4-shims stylesheet so `fa`/`fas` render identically today, but this keeps the row's markup consistent with itself.

## Test plan

- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='OwnStockRowMarkup|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews'` — 15 tests, 800 assertions, all green.
- [x] Screenshots (seeded dealer/order with a transport-eligible vehicle), before/after, 1440px and 390px: the truck's ink matches preview/edit after the change. Confirmed programmatically too — before: truck `rgb(152,162,179)` vs preview/edit `rgb(71,84,103)`; after: all three `rgb(71,84,103)`.
params.title: Row action icons share one ink
